name: strategy and development committee
normative-structure: The firm as a whole has a decided concept — an organization-level concept of operations stating leadership's intended way of operating the organization, every system it operates treated as a black box — because this office decided it at a cadence, as a committee, on evidence it did not produce. It persists across incumbents because the question does: left to no cadence, the firm's operating intent is whichever prose a session last stated, revised by no one, checked against nothing, and every downstream funding and continuation decision inherits it by accident rather than by any stated act. This office does not hold what the firm's endeavor means — that is the founder's, exercised as direction and position rather than as a committee record — and it decides neither what a line may spend, which is the investment review board's, above every checkpoint, nor whether chartered work continues, which is the integrated portfolio management team's, at each checkpoint on evidence it did not produce. What this office decides sits prior to both: the organization-level concept those two altitudes answer to when they ask whether a line or a checkpoint still serves what the firm intends. It convenes as a committee rather than acting through one officer, because the concept it commits binds every line at once, and a single officer's read of the firm's intent is a session's opinion until a committee has taken evidence — including a business-or-mission-analysis characterizing the space of candidate solutions — and committed one reading of it as the standing concept, on a cadence, until the next one supersedes it. That cadence is annual: the committee convenes once each year, within thirty days of the anniversary of its founding (2026-07-16), to restate or revise the organization-level concept of operations; revise-the-concept-between-cadences already holds as a liberty, so an interim correction does not require calling a second full convening.
theory-basis: huidu-guanli/sdc: Huawei's Strategy & Development Committee (战略与发展委员会, SDC) is the board-level committee that owns the firm's strategy-formulation cadence — market insight, opportunity framing, and the organization-level operating concept — prior to and above the IPD funding line the investment review board and integrated portfolio management team run; the SDC decides what the firm intends, not what any one line may spend or whether chartered work continues

huidu-guanli/dste: the IBM-lineage Business Leadership Model (BLM) and its DSTE (Develop Strategy To Execution) process are the strategy-formulation discipline Huawei's SDC runs at a fixed cadence — market and customer insight distilled into strategic intent, business design, and a validated concept — feeding the IPD chain rather than replacing it; this office's cadence and its concept-of-operations duty are that discipline's realization in this firm

huidu-guanli/dste (cadence): BLM/DSTE runs its strategy-formulation cycle once per year — insight, strategic intent, and business design revisited annually, with interim course-correction handled short of a second full cycle — the shape this office's stated cadence adopts directly: annual, anchored to its 2026-07-16 founding date, with revision between cadences already held as the liberty revise-the-concept-between-cadences rather than a second full convening

lib/emsenn/services/561-group/services/board-of-directors/services/executive-office/lib/characters/emsenn/content/documents/articles/notes/2026/07/14/2026-07-14-note-on-huidu-guanli-of-emsenn.md: 灰度管理 (grey-scale management) — 方向大致正确，组织充满活力, the direction roughly correct, the organization full of vitality — is emsenn's own stated method of rule; this office is where that roughly-correct direction is committed as a decided, dated organization-level concept rather than remaining prose only emsenn's own correction-by-mouth ever checks against reality; the note is drafted-for-canonization, not yet ruled canon, and is cited here as the theory object it is rather than as settled law

ISO/IEC/IEEE 15288:2023 §6.4.1 Business or Mission Analysis: the process that defines the problem-or-opportunity space and characterizes candidate solution classes ahead of any organization-level ConOps committing to one of them — this office's performing-a-business-or-mission-analysis duty is that process, run before the concept it feeds, never after

ISO 37000:2021: purpose is the governing body's primary responsibility; this committee decides the firm's organization-level operating concept under delegation from the governing body, and states that concept so the governing body's purpose is carried into an operating intent rather than left to infer one from the portfolio's own momentum

ISO 56002:2019: the innovation management system's concept-creation-and-validation pipeline — insight and opportunity turned into a characterized, validated concept before it is committed — is the same shape this office's business-or-mission-analysis and concept-of-operations duties realize in sequence
unrealized: the stated annual cadence has been decided but not yet practiced — no convening has occurred under it, so it is a rule on the record and not yet a history of sessions held to it

no organization-level concept of operations has been written under this office; the duty is seated and the instrument exists (writing-a-concept-of-operations) but no document has been produced through it
no business-or-mission-analysis record has been produced through this office; the duty and instrument are seated and unused

whether this office's seating narrows the founder's own hold on what the firm's endeavor means, or only states that meaning as a dated record without touching who holds it, is a leader-decision the CCB's chartering ruling did not reach and this seating does not resolve
the committee has no named incumbents; whether it is one body or convenes from among the investment review board and integrated portfolio management team's own membership is undecided
